fusions.name: Draw the Venom
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target: a bite draws the poison out for 8 damage, consuming every affliction on the target and adding half their remaining damage to the blow. You heal for 25% of the damage dealt and move 15% faster for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Bitterness Returned
fusions.desc: You dart in and spit poison across everything within 3 tiles ahead of you, dealing 10 poison damage and leaving each target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to enemies within 3.5 tiles of it, and you move 20% faster for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Bait Refused
fusions.desc: Removes up to 2 poison conditions from you, restores 8 health, and backs you 2 tiles away from where you stood.

fusions.name: Taster's Tolerance
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, you regain 2 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds. You also have 10% poison resistance and 5% more dodge chance.
